class.name: JRPGConditionalBranchCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: runs commands only when a condition holds, with an optional else branch.
class.description: Runs [member then_list] when its condition holds; otherwise runs [member else_list] when [member else_enabled] is on. The condition is chosen by [member condition], and each kind reads some of the other members: - [constant CONDITION_SWITCH]: switch [member target_id] is ON ([member expected] [code]true[/code]) or OFF. - [constant CONDITION_VARIABLE]: variable [member target_id] compared ([member comparison]) with [member operand], or with variable [member operand] when [member operand_is_variable]. Numbers compare as numbers and texts as texts; a number never matches a text. - [constant CONDITION_SELF_SWITCH]: self switch [member self_switch] of this event is ON or OFF ([member expected]). - [constant CONDITION_TIMER]: the timer works and its remaining seconds compare with [member operand]. - [constant CONDITION_ACTOR]: actor [member target_id] is in the party, or has the name [member text], the class, skill, weapon, armor or state [member operand], as [member actor_check] says. An actor not yet in the game is set up as it would be on joining. - [constant CONDITION_CHARACTER]: the player ([constant CHARACTER_PLAYER]), this event ([constant CHARACTER_THIS_EVENT]) or event [member target_id] of the map faces [member direction]. - [constant CONDITION_GOLD]: the party's gold compares with [member operand]. - [constant CONDITION_ITEM], [constant CONDITION_WEAPON], [constant CONDITION_ARMOR]: the party holds item, weapon or armor [member target_id]; weapons and armors equipped by party members count when [member include_equipped]. - [constant CONDITION_BUTTON]: action [member button] is pressed (held), triggered (pressed this frame) or repeated, as [member button_check] says. - [constant CONDITION_SCRIPT]: the formula [member script_text] ([JRPGFormula]: variables as [code]v[lb]n[rb][/code] and the deterministic helpers) is not 0. - [constant CONDITION_ENEMY], [constant CONDITION_VEHICLE]: false, with one warning, until battles and vehicles exist. A target that does not exist (an actor the database lacks, an event that is not on the map, "this event" in a run that has none) makes the condition false, with one warning per command. Authority: server, except the button condition, which reads the local player's input.

method.name: compare
method.description: Returns how [param a] compares with [param b]. Numbers compare as numbers, texts as texts; a number and a text give [code]false[/code].

method.name: holds
method.description: Returns whether the condition holds for the run [param context] (a [JRPGInterpreter]).

method.name: is_repeat_step
method.description: Returns whether a button held [param held_steps] simulation steps (0: just pressed) repeats now: on the press, [constant REPEAT_DELAY_STEPS] steps later, then every [constant REPEAT_INTERVAL_STEPS].
